units.rawText: Who... are you?
units.displayText: Who... are you?

spans.text: Who... are you?

units.rawText: A cold gleam of light points directly between my eyes and behind it, an agent warily approaches me with a drawn bow.
units.displayText: A cold gleam of light points directly between my eyes and behind it, an agent warily approaches me with a drawn bow.

spans.text: A cold gleam of light points directly between my eyes and behind it, an agent warily approaches me with a drawn bow.

units.rawText: I sense no hidden malice about you, and no intention to sneak past. If you are neither an enemy who seeks to defile this place nor an interloper, then who are you?
units.displayText: I sense no hidden malice about you, and no intention to sneak past. If you are neither an enemy who seeks to defile this place nor an interloper, then who are you?

spans.text: I sense no hidden malice about you, and no intention to sneak past. If you are neither an enemy who seeks to defile this place nor an interloper, then who are you?

units.rawText: I am the leader of the Oasis, also known as the Professor.
units.displayText: I am the leader of the Oasis, also known as the Professor.

spans.text: I am the leader of the Oasis, also known as the Professor.

units.rawText: The Oasis'... Professor? How strange, this is the first time I have heard this name, yet you seem oddly familiar.
units.displayText: The Oasis'... Professor? How strange, this is the first time I have heard this name, yet you seem oddly familiar.

spans.text: The Oasis'... Professor? How strange, this is the first time I have heard this name, yet you seem oddly familiar.

units.rawText: No matter. The blame for rudeness lies with me. This bow strikes down evil beasts far and wide and banishes the foe that seeks to pass, but it should never have been pointed at a friend who came from afar.
units.displayText: No matter. The blame for rudeness lies with me. This bow strikes down evil beasts far and wide and banishes the foe that seeks to pass, but it should never have been pointed at a friend who came from afar.

spans.text: No matter. The blame for rudeness lies with me. This bow strikes down evil beasts far and wide and banishes the foe that seeks to pass, but it should never have been pointed at a friend who came from afar.

units.rawText: <size=28>Weren't you pointing it at me just now?</size>
units.displayText: Weren't you pointing it at me just now?

spans.text: Weren't you pointing it at me just now?

units.rawText: Ahem...
units.displayText: Ahem...

spans.text: Ahem...

units.rawText: My apologies for my rashness and rudeness. If you don't mind, would you be willing to accept a humble token of my contrition?
units.displayText: My apologies for my rashness and rudeness. If you don't mind, would you be willing to accept a humble token of my contrition?

spans.text: My apologies for my rashness and rudeness. If you don't mind, would you be willing to accept a humble token of my contrition?

units.rawText: This is...
units.displayText: This is...

spans.text: This is...

units.rawText: It is jerky made from the flesh of the beasts which inhabit the Járnviðr, and the only thing I possess on me which I can offer as a gift. Please try some; that way I can—
units.displayText: It is jerky made from the flesh of the beasts which inhabit the Járnviðr, and the only thing I possess on me which I can offer as a gift. Please try some; that way I can—

spans.text: It is jerky made from the flesh of the beasts which inhabit the Járnviðr, and the only thing I possess on me which I can offer as a gift. Please try some; that way I can—

units.rawText: Crack—
units.displayText: Crack—

spans.text: Crack—

units.rawText: The sound does not come from the jerky I am holding.
units.displayText: The sound does not come from the jerky I am holding.

spans.text: The sound does not come from the jerky I am holding.

units.rawText: That sound just now was... Are your teeth alright?
units.displayText: That sound just now was... Are your teeth alright?

spans.text: That sound just now was... Are your teeth alright?

units.rawText: They're not doing too good... This stuff is way too hard!
units.displayText: They're not doing too good... This stuff is way too hard!

spans.text: They're not doing too good... This stuff is way too hard!

units.rawText: My apologies! I will heal you immediately!
units.displayText: My apologies! I will heal you immediately!

spans.text: My apologies! I will heal you immediately!

units.rawText: Saying so, she takes a huge bonesaw out of her pack, along with some bubbling, dark green unguent and a frightening-looking object that looks like a file.
units.displayText: Saying so, she takes a huge bonesaw out of her pack, along with some bubbling, dark green unguent and a frightening-looking object that looks like a file.

spans.text: Saying so, she takes a huge bonesaw out of her pack, along with some bubbling, dark green unguent and a frightening-looking object that looks like a file.

units.rawText: Hang on, I don't think you need to heal me.
units.displayText: Hang on, I don't think you need to heal me.

spans.text: Hang on, I don't think you need to heal me.

units.rawText: Huh? But...
units.displayText: Huh? But...

spans.text: Huh? But...

units.rawText: I just remembered that I had something to do, so I need to go. And don't worry about me... I have friends who can help take care of that minor wound for me.
units.displayText: I just remembered that I had something to do, so I need to go. And don't worry about me... I have friends who can help take care of that minor wound for me.

spans.text: I just remembered that I had something to do, so I need to go. And don't worry about me... I have friends who can help take care of that minor wound for me.

units.rawText: Hm? Very well, then... Once again, I apologize for my rashness.
units.displayText: Hm? Very well, then... Once again, I apologize for my rashness.

spans.text: Hm? Very well, then... Once again, I apologize for my rashness.

units.rawText: Please take care on your travels. I will endeavor to treat you with more hospitality the next time you visit the Járnviðr.
units.displayText: Please take care on your travels. I will endeavor to treat you with more hospitality the next time you visit the Járnviðr.

spans.text: Please take care on your travels. I will endeavor to treat you with more hospitality the next time you visit the Járnviðr.

units.rawText: Alright, I'll remember that.
units.displayText: Alright, I'll remember that.

spans.text: Alright, I'll remember that.
